List of current biomes in which the „%s“ placed feature will be generated.

The probability that this sub-feature is chosen during feature generation. Values are evaluated in order from top to bottom, and the first successful chance check is selected. For example, if two sub-features both have a 100% chance, the first one will always be chosen and the second one will never generate. If no sub-feature is selected, the default feature is used.
